spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Wildcat Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 186 m (610 ft).

spots.name: Vista Point Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing south. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Natural Dam Waterfall
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 2 m (8 ft) tall.
